content.content: 1. The dist plan names exactly the four targets the decision lists — aarch64-apple-darwin, x86_64-apple-darwin, aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu — no more, no fewer. Fail on any missing or extra target — name it. 2. Each workflow names the crate the manifest declares, and the publish workflow runs `cargo publish`. Fail on any mismatch — name it.
content.rationale: The release is machinery a tag runs, not prose a reader judges: the dist plan and the crate names in the workflows are its checkable surface, so the check reads those rather than the yaml's intent.
